# AI-Namer
> AI-Namer is an intelligent domain name generator that uses artificial intelligence to create and check availability of domain names for your business, startup, project, website, blog, e-commerce store, or online platform.

AI-Namer helps entrepreneurs, small business owners, startups, freelancers, marketers, developers, content creators, and branding specialists find available domain names that perfectly match their brand vision and business goals. Our advanced tool combines creative naming techniques with real-time domain availability checking to ensure you get actionable, brandable, and memorable domain suggestions without the hassle of manual brainstorming.

Whether you're launching a tech startup, creating a personal blog, building an e-commerce store, developing a SaaS platform, starting a consulting business, or establishing your online presence, AI-Namer streamlines the domain name search process. We leverage cutting-edge AI models to generate domain names that are SEO-friendly, easy to remember, brand-appropriate, and available for registration across popular TLDs like .com, .org, .net, .io, and more.

Key benefits include:
- Time-saving AI-powered domain name generation
- Instant availability checking across multiple registrars
- 12 different naming styles for creative flexibility
- Customizable parameters (length, TLDs, keywords)
- Favorites system to save and compare options
- Support for various industries and niches
- Smart suggestions based on your business description
- Multilingual domain name ideas
- Alternative spelling variations
- Brandable and memorable domain options

## Core Features
- [Domain Generator](https://ai-namer.com): Generate domain names using AI with 12 different naming styles
- [Domain Availability](https://ai-namer.com): Check domain availability across multiple registrars including GoDaddy, Namecheap, and Cloudflare
- [Favorites System](https://ai-namer.com): Save and manage your favorite domain names
- [Customization Options](https://ai-namer.com): Specify preferred TLDs, maximum length, and include specific keywords

## Naming Styles
- [Auto](https://ai-namer.com): Mix of all styles for diverse suggestions
- [Descriptive](https://ai-namer.com): Directly describes what you do (e.g., PlayStation.com, HomeDepot.com)
- [Clever](https://ai-namer.com): Uses wordplay or puns (e.g., Dunkin.com, LinkedIn.com)
- [Alliteration](https://ai-namer.com): Words with the same starting sound (e.g., BestBuy.com, PayPal.com)
- [Metaphor](https://ai-namer.com): Uses symbolic meaning (e.g., Amazon.com, Nike.com)
- [Brandable](https://ai-namer.com): Unique, made-up names (e.g., Google.com, Spotify.com)
- [Evocative](https://ai-namer.com): Evokes emotions or imagery (e.g., Twitter.com, Safari.com)
- [Short Phrase](https://ai-namer.com): Brief, memorable phrases (e.g., JustDoIt.com, ThinkPad.com)
- [Compound](https://ai-namer.com): Combines related terms (e.g., Facebook.com, WordPress.com)
- [Alternate Spelling](https://ai-namer.com): Creative spelling variations (e.g., Fiverr.com, Tumblr.com)
- [Word Hack](https://ai-namer.com): Adds prefixes/suffixes to words (e.g., Spotify.com, Shopify.com)
- [Non-English](https://ai-namer.com): Uses foreign words (e.g., Zappos.com, Hulu.com)

## AI Models
- [OpenRouter](https://ai-namer.com): Google Gemini 2.5 Flash Lite (`google/gemini-2.5-flash-lite`)

## TLD Options
- [.com](https://ai-namer.com): Most popular top-level domain
- [.org](https://ai-namer.com): For organizations and non-profits
- [.net](https://ai-namer.com): Originally for network organizations
- [.io](https://ai-namer.com): Popular for tech companies and startups
- [.ai](https://ai-namer.com): For AI and technology companies
- [.app](https://ai-namer.com): For applications and software
- [.dev](https://ai-namer.com): For developers and development projects
- [.xyz](https://ai-namer.com): General purpose domain extension
